We're approaching 100 users in Chrome, so I thought I'd give a quick run-down of the current status and future plans.

I've updated the Chrome extension and Firefox add-on to version 0.5 which leaves us in a solid "beta" state.

New

Version 0.5 introduces some new features, including:

  • Open submissions in background tabs (Ctrl + Enter, Ctrl + C)
  • Automatically load more comments when reaching the end
  • Press C to continue comment threads in place
  • Reply with R, and submit with Ctrl + Enter

Shortcuts

Here's a run-down of all shortcuts. As always, these are fully customizable by opening Help (Shift + ?) and clicking Options.

  • J / K - move to next/previous entry
  • A / Z - upvote/downvote
  • X - toggle expando (P to open expando & play video)
  • I - go to inbox (Shift for new tab, Ctrl for background tab)
  • N - open log-in dialog
  • Ctrl + E / Y - move to next/previous entry and scroll

Link-only shortcuts

  • Enter - open link (Shift for new tab, Ctrl for background tab)
  • C - open comments (Shift for new tab, Ctrl for background tab)
  • L - open link and comments in new tabs (Shift for background tab) Shift + J / K - next/previous page of links

Comment-only shortcuts

  • R - reply
  • Ctrl + Enter - submit reply
  • Shift + J / K - next/previous sibling comment
  • U - move to parent comment (Shift for topmost comment)
  • 1 - 9 - open the 1st/2nd/.../9th link in a comment

And of course, ? aka Shift + / to open the help dialog to see shortcuts that work on the given page.

Upcoming

I've got a long to-do list, including:

  • More navigation -- open subverse, user page, search, etc.
  • Style the selected comment better, ideally using subverse styles
  • Improve the Options page and make it easier to set shortcuts for background tabs
  • Make link-only shortcuts work on OP submission in the comments

I'll prioritize based on any feedback I get. So please leave comments here, post to this subverse, leave feedback in the Chrome webstore or Firefox add-on center, PM me directly or ping me on #voat in /v/BaphoNet.
